correctness.rationale: For every b>=2 and r>=4, both directions follow from congruence-preserving finite cyclic carrying and explicit reverse-carry witnesses with pairwise distinct base-b exponents. The exact genus is a floor sum on a reduced coprime lattice, and the greatest gap comes from the zero residue class. Every boundary (b=2, d>1, c=1, a=1) is addressed. A separate verifier passed 1518 exact finite-weight decisions in 34 settings and 1260 positive witnesses, not claimed as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two-parameter generalized-repunit family is a natural extension of the explicit output-set/Frobenius questions. Its fully determined spectrum and sharp genus/conductor in the relevant gcd-lattice close the exact arithmetic classification for all lengths >=4. This is a structural, uniform and genuinely quantitative answer, not only a finite example or a renamed known theorem.
